children: California Water Service Group agreed to issue $125M of senior unsecured notes and $150M of first mortgage bonds to refinance debt and fund general purposes.
$75M of 6.08% Senior Unsecured Notes due 12/15/2031 and $50M of 6.41% Senior Unsecured Notes due 12/15/2036 to be issued by the Group.
Cal Water to issue $50M of 6.49% First Mortgage Bonds due 12/15/2046 and $100M of 6.54% First Mortgage Bonds due 12/15/2056.
Notes and Bonds expected to be issued on or before 12/31/2026; interest paid semi-annually beginning 6/15/2027.
Proceeds planned to refinance existing indebtedness and for general corporate purposes; Bonds secured by first mortgage liens.
